results.title: Christmas Party Games Bundle, 8 Holiday Trivia, Bingo, Would You Rather (Digital Download)
results.description:
Make your Christmas party easy and fun with 8 ready-to-play printable games. Print, grab some pens, and everyone from kids to grandparents can join in.
Perfect for family gatherings, office parties, classrooms and holiday get-togethers with 4 to 30 people.

WHAT'S INCLUDED (13-page PDF)
- How to play and print page with host tips
- Christmas Trivia (20 questions) with answer key
- Holiday Word Scramble (20 words) with answer key
- Would You Rather: Holiday Edition (20 cut-out cards)
- This or That: Christmas Edition (20 pairs)
- Find the Guest Bingo (mingle game)
- Who Am I? Holiday Edition (18 cut-out cards)
- Carol Title Fill-In (20 classic carols) with answer key
- Christmas Scavenger Hunt (kids list and adults list)
- Party Scorecard to crown your champion

DETAILS
- US Letter size, also prints on A4 (choose Fit or Actual Size)
- Mostly black and white with a red accent, so it is ink friendly
- Print as many copies as you need for your own party

HOW TO DOWNLOAD
This is a digital PDF download. Nothing will be shipped. After purchase, go to Purchases and Reviews in your Etsy account (or the email from Etsy) and click Download Files. Then print at home or at a local print shop.

For personal use only. Please do not resell or share the file.

This design was created with AI assistance under the creative direction of the seller.
